name: Planetfall
description: Entity Imposter's valley set on Entity Origin's real-scale Earth: one floating-origin camera flies from the valley floor up to Gateway Station in orbit and on to Neptune, the valley staying exact under it. The valley's sun is the solar system's.

entities.$comment: the solar system: its sky (space) and its Sun are the world's
where the valley stands: a site on the day side of the Earth, its frame the ground's (y up); sunProbe: its sun direction is in sol's stats
the valley rides on the site, 30 m up so its lowest ground stays above the sphere (the Earth curves 0.2 m away over its 1.6 km)
the solar system's flight drives the camera (Walk hands it to the engine's, on the valley's ground); the valley's sun is the Sun as seen from it
